title: Shujinkou-sama no Imouto ni Aisarete Irukedo, Shikkari Yandere.
titleRomaji: Shujinkou-sama no Imouto ni Aisarete Irukedo, Shikkari Yandere.
titleNative: 主人公様の妹に愛されているけど、しっかりヤンデレ。
synopsis: High school boy Shinji Usui has a childhood friend named Hinata Ichinose — a guy who’s handsome and incredibly popular with girls, just like the hero of a rom-com. Being around Hinata, who’s as radiant and captivating as the sun, made Shinji feel pitiful by comparison, so at some point, he began to feel a bit uncomfortable around him. On the other hand, Hinata’s younger sister, Tsukina, treats him more kindly than she treats her own brother, for some reason. The story begins when Shinji — who has been trying to come to terms with these complex feelings — receives an ominously worded love letter. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Moriagaranai Date
titleNative: 盛りあがらないデート
synopsis: A So-So Match on a Dating App… Haida, cursed with chronic bad luck, signs up for a dating app as part of her “what-the-heck” phase. She matches with Kuroi, a man who joined for equally reckless reasons. But their conversation never quite clicks, and an unmistakably low-key, awkward mood sets in. Everything they do backfires, resulting in a date that is astonishingly unexciting. Thinking there’s no way there will be a second date in an atmosphere like this… wait, what? Why are they making plans to meet again!? A first date with someone you met on a dating app that just doesn’t take off? The deadpan, surreal banter is way too addictive! A slow-burn, gently unfolding romance that begins with a dating app.

synopsis: My grotesque (stalker), protects me from 100 stalkers in order to eat me. Sakurai Aoi, a high school boy, has a secret that he can tell no one. He's been a victim of stalking since childhood. One day Ueda Miyako, a classmate, suddenly turned into a monster. She was the one who was stalking Sakurai. The beautiful Miyako, who has been around Sakurai for a long time, was taken care of, but the monsters in urban legends all over Japan are stalking in order to love themselves. The fate of Sakurai, who is loved by the mysterious name of hundreds of beautiful women, is... It's a great point to start! Pure love story about a man's love, greed and illness who was attracted by grotesque girls. (Source: The Vanilla Frosty Scan)

title: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleRomaji: "Koko wa Makasete Saki ni Ike!" wo Shitai Shinitagari no Nozomanu Uchuu Gekokujou @COMIC
titleEnglish: Reluctant Space Commander: From Death Wish to Galactic Hero!
titleNative: 「ここは任せて先に行け！」をしたい死にたがりの望まぬ宇宙下剋上@COMIC
synopsis: Nao has had it rough. His girlfriend dumped him and ran off with another man, and now his life has lost all meaning. As he contemplates suicide, he catches sight of an advertisement for Space Force—a military force dedicated to protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats. Finally, a sign that maybe he can do more with his pathetic existence! Without a moment’s hesitation, he joins the force with a simple plan in mind: he’ll sacrifice himself for his comrades after a suave line and be free. Except…Nao is too good at this job! Like, really good—there’s no way he’ll die on his own at this rate! Can Nao find his sweet release, or will he become a hero and have to live with it? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
